{{Quote|Bettle and Jaxa have been busy marketing slug throwers to various warring primitive species in an undisclosed region just beyond the Corporate Sector. ''[&hellip;]'' They've rebounded nicely, though, returning to semi-civilized space with cargo holds bulging with canta salt and havao tabacc. The ''Mallixer'' is in need of repairs again. Last known heading was Bretta.|A news report by Cynabar's InfoNet|<ref name="GNN">{{JournalCite|5|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>}}
'''Bretta''' was a location in the [[Bretta system/Legends|Bretta system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> On the [[Great ReSynchronization calendar|date]] [[0 ABY/Legends|36:1:16]], a news report by [[Cynabar's InfoNet/Legends|Cynabar's InfoNet]] mentioned it as the last known heading for<ref name="GNN" /> the [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Heroes&Rogues">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref> [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Bettle]] and<ref name="GNN" /> her<ref name="Heroes&Rogues" /> partner [[Jaxa]], who had returned from a profitable run to territories beyond the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] with large amounts of [[canta salt]] and [[havao tabacc]] in the cargo holds of their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Mallixer]]'', albeit with the craft also needing repairs.<ref name="GNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bretta was introduced by [[Paul Sudlow]] in the "[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]" feature of the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|fifth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine, which was published in [[February]] [[1995]].<ref name="GNN" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Bretta [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby Bretta itself, in grid square N-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
